why: fence.rs is in the run process build, and blaze-ids is now only a dev-dependency of blaze-inproc (the run process links the crate with blaze-mem and libc only). Moving Fences::used onto blaze_ids::bits::BitArray would put blake3, serde, smallvec and thin-vec into every run process for 32 bytes of bitset; kept as is on purpose, like the LEB128 in 00317.
